name: Sterling Barber Co.
tagline: Classic cuts and razor shaves in the old town of Lviv.
description: Sterling Barber Co. is a traditional barbershop in the centre of Lviv: classic haircuts, skin fades, beard work and hot towel shaves by appointment.

hero.title: Sterling Barber Co.
hero.subtitle: A proper old-fashioned shop: leather chairs, hot towels, a sharp razor and a barber who takes his time.
